Attuned: Grimburn
Charges: 0 (ON, PROD to toggle)
Lich's Curse: 0% (ON, TAP to toggle)

Analysis of a keg-emblazoned basket indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Welcome to the Basketifier, straight out of the shop Preserving Breads at Evermore Hollow!
This basket is designed to hold food items for you.  It will keep them fresh and unlimited until you decide to remove them.
It is currently tier 4 of 4, which means it will house 24 food items.
To use the basket, simply follow these steps:
1. PUT - use this to add food items to the basket.
2. RUB - use this to prepare a food item for removal.
3. TURN - Use this to remove a food item from the basket.  (must be charged with a small statue)
To create a picnic, follow these steps:
1. PULL - to pull the blanket out.  This will move all food to the blanket, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. PUSH - to clean up the picnic.  This will move all food and the blanket back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.

This is a standard tent and will be knocked down by hostile creatures.  The owner may have one guest.

The standing version of the tent may be altered with a long description, but not a show.  The description must include "canvas tent."  The interior of the tent may be changed by rare merchants as a delayed service, or for Premium Points via Sadie Scroll.
Exterior:
a navy canvas tent spangled with silver stars
Interior:
[Brodega's Tent]

Sheer white gossamer panels drape down from above, tied back to fall smoothly against the navy canvas walls.  Hanging from the tent poles above is an unlit bright silver lantern.  A dark blue silk prayer rug fringed in white stretches across the ground.  The scent of incense permeates the air.
When the lantern is lit:

Sheer white gossamer panels drape down from above, tied back to fall smoothly against the navy canvas walls.  A star-punched bright silver lantern casts light across the walls of the tent, causing the silver stars to sparkle in a dazzling display.  A dark blue silk prayer rug fringed in white stretches across the ground.  The scent of incense permeates the air.

The room interior can be altered to reference a placed lantern, bedroll, storage container, trash can, or scent.  If not referenced, additional sentences will be appended to display them.  There is a 511 character limit total on the room descriptions.  Any items not referenced will show in the room as "You also see...".  The items will not be linked in the room description; you can ANALYZE inside the tent to see the items that are placed there to interact with.
You can STAND the tent to pitch it, and FOLD it to take it down.  You can also CLEAN, LEAN, or KNOCK on the tent.
PLACE the following items in your tent to store or remove them from the room:

* Perfume bottles, oil lamps and oils, or incense to impart a temporary fragrance to the tent.  This will temporarily override the custom fragrance of incense, which will be restored the next time the tent is erected.  The scent is currently: incense
* One General Store lantern or torch, which can then be lit to light the room: a star-punched bright silver lantern is currently placed in the tent.
* One General Store bedroll; meditation mat; prayer rug; taxidermied rug; or folding chair: a dark blue silk prayer rug fringed in white is currently placed in the tent.
* One Pup Tent Storage Container: None.
PROD the tent flap to allow open access to the tent.

raw: The runestaff is shaped from pale-golden surita, its polished grain flowing in soft, natural undulations. Near the crown, the markings converge around a smooth knot of wood that gleams like a moonlit tidepool.    It has a small enchanter's glyph.  A strange necrotic haze radiates from the asaya.  A strong aura of holy light radiates from the asaya.

A moonlit surita asaya inked with dachre spirals is a Gift from Atan Irith and created from a rare piece of surita.  The surita tree is only found on the Erithi Homeland, though it was sold at The Grand Tourney.
This particular piece is constructed of ocean surita, which has a white woodgrain striated by moss agate and indigo hues.
If you give your surita asaya a long description, or leave it without an examine or description, then you will always be able to look at to see the above information.

The auction block can be used as a tool and prop for setting up your own auctions and raffles.

Alteration Guidelines:
The auction block can be altered freely as long as it still reflects being some sort of flat container with an interior and flat upper surface for displaying items for examination.
A gavel is used for messaging which can also be altered, but it must remain a "gavel" and cannot have a long or show.
The two raffle table props, the tickets, and barrel, can also be altered.  However, they, too, must keep the noun "tickets" and "barrel" and cannot have shows or longs.
Usage:
To run an auction: PUT the prize(s) (if desired) on the auction block for your customers to INSPECT and ANALYZE.
PUSH the auction block to toggle between runner-up and non-runner up modes.
BID <amount> block to set the starting bid amount.
POUND the block to begin bidding!
Bidders should BID <amount> block to up their bids.
POKE the block to announce the current bid and progress through once, twice, three times.
POUND the block to end bidding.
The winning bidder will get five minutes to return with a note large enough to cover their bid, after which DROPping it in the block will give them the prize(s) you have placed on top (if any).
To run a raffle, PULL the auction block to place tickets and a raffle barrel on top of the auction block.
PUSH the auction block to toggle between one ticket per customer or multiple tickets allowed.
TURN the auction block to select which line of credit to store your raffle proceeds in.
WRITE ticket;prize <description> to set the description on the tickets.
WRITE ticket;price # to set the cost of each ticket.
Wait until tickets have been collected in the barrel.
Up to 99 tickets can be purchased.
SPIN the barrel to draw a name.
SPIN the barrel more times to draw more names.
If any tickets have been purchased, you must SPIN the barrel at least once before you can stop the raffle.
The list of winners can be reviewed by LOOKing at the tickets.
CLEAN the barrel after SPINning to reset the raffle.

raw: Crafted in a Tehir style, the nakaten bears a minimal pommel and stirrups that hang down at a middling length.

Analysis of a yierka hide nakaten with linen-wrapped pommel rings indicates the creator has provided the following information:
--------- TIU & QAITEKE LIZARD SADDLES - ANALYZE INFO  ---------
This nakaten is a Tiu & Qaiteke saddle meant for use with "lizard" mounts.
Verb Sets active on this nakaten:
*Verb Set 1:  DROP/PUT, GET, MOUNT (with styles), and DISMOUNT (with styles).
MOUNT styles -- MOUNT {STYLE} {target lizard} -- that are valid for this nakaten's current setup are:  RIGHT, LEFT, JUMP, LEG, CROUCH, BATTLECRY
DISMOUNT styles -- DISMOUNT {STYLE} -- that are valid for this nakaten's current setup are: RIGHT, LEFT, JUMP, SLIDE, LEG, CROUCH, BATTLECRY
--------- ALTERATION INFORMATION ---------

The noun cannot change.  So what can you do?  Any merchant may alter the article, adjective, and/or long description of the nakaten.  They can also add a show description that will append to the hard-coded LOOK.  All alterations must be in keeping with the saddle's style (see below).  It is also recommended that you avoid show descriptions that rely on the long description for future-forward accessory use that temporarily changes the long description.

Note that some aspects of the LOOK are hard-coded (such as the length of the stirrups) and cannot currently be modified by a merchant.  Currently, the pommel ring is set up as double, which CAN be swapped out (between single and double) by willing merchants.

This saddle's style (which is not currently eligible to be changed to another style) is set to nakaten (Tehir).  For alteration purposes, keep the following in mind:  It has a flat, wide seat, a minimal pommel, and no gullet.  Instead of a horn, it has a "pommel ring(s)" -- either a single upright ring or double outward angled rings that jut out from the pommel area.  It has a high, back-angled cantle with a fantail.  The strap system includes forward and rear girth straps that connect via the legs and front of the chest.  Saddle blanket ("nakatela" in Tehir) use is common, and pads are never used.  It is heavy compared to other saddle styles.
The yierka hide nakaten will cost 2,000,000 coins.

Preserved under a purple-tinted lacquer, the haon device is accented with silver toggles, gears, buttons, and levers.  Glass rods are visible within a window that takes up the entire left side, the uppermost one completely clear.  A small door on the back has a flashing dull circle of amber over it, while a nearby window flashes with the number "0."  Another window, next to a small knob, has a readout of the word "paint" within its oblong frame.  Attached to the bottom of the device is a simple sterling silver plaque affixed to its side that is bound in place with silver screws and has crisp lettering engraved into its smooth face proclaiming, "~*~ The Paint-in-ator 3000 ~*~."

Attached to the bottom of the device is a simple  plaque affixed to its side that is bound in place with  screws and has crisp lettering engraved into its smooth face proclaiming "~*~ The Paint-in-ator 3000 ~*~".
The device can be worn, attaching it to the belt.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of wood, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a dark-banded haon device indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Welcome to the one, the only, and the never-before-seen "Paint-in-ator 3000"!

This incredible, amazing, and often underestimated item will thrill you with its ability to store paint.  That's right, Brodega!  It stores paint!  If you aren't sure what to do with paint, then you clearly do not understand the physical strain of a crafter!
Instructions:
1. Hold your paint in hand
2. POUR your paint IN the Paint-in-ator 3000
3. Marvel at the relief to your shoulders as you shed weight
4. GAZE at your Paint-in-ator 3000 to see all the stored paints
Retrieval Instructions:
1. PUSH a crystal amulet (or any of its cousins) into the Paint-in-ator.  (she's a hungry beast!)
2. TAP the Paint-in-ator to determine how many doses you want to retrieve (options: 1 - 5)
3. SPIN the Paint-in-ator to cycle through all the stored paint (50 is max)
4. TURN the Paint-in-ator to collect your paint
Please note, any paints poured into the "Paint-in-ator 3000" are consumed by it and can only be retrieved using the methods listed above.
That's right, Brodega, it is that simple!
But wait!  There's more!  If you aren't satisfied with the plain, the boring, or the OFF-the-SHELF Paint-in-ator, then you can obtain an UNLOCK certificate for better convenience and goodness!

The Paint-in-ator has the following commands: gaze (displays all stored paint), pour (adds paint to device), pull (removes crystal amulet from device), push (adds crystal amulet to device), spin (cycles through available paint), tap (cycles through doses to create), and turn (provides paint)
The "Paint-in-ator 3000" is Tier 1 (OTS) of 2.

Altering Instructions:  The Paint-in-ator must always be a box of some kind and must always be belt-worn.  Due to its complicated (patent pending) dials, chambers, switches, and toggles, it can never support a SHOW DESCRIPTION, but it can handle long descriptions.

Disclaimers:  The Paint-in-ator is a sensitive device and as such its creators wish to remind you that it is made for good fun.  As a result, it has restrictions on it to prevent the harm of small children and animals.  The creators do not want any accusations of "The Paint-in-ator ate my baby!"  Please be sure to always use the Paint-in-ator appropriately.  Drinking while using the Paint-in-ator forfeits all warranties, guarantees, and most lacquers.  Do not place your hands in the device while it is in use, as the creators will not be held responsible for missing digits.  And, for the love of all that is holy, do not bring a knife anywhere near it.  Do not use in the bath, as the creators will not be held responsible for what may happen.  For your safety, do not break these rules.

items.name: a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome

raw: The brass and gold capsule is divided into two halves, with the top portion being crafted from glass and the bottom portion wrought from brass and gold.  Through the transparent glass, ten chambers are exposed inside the capsule, each detailed with a miniature replica of the cities and towns across Elanthia.  A glowing ring surrounds the chamber for Wehnimer's Landing currently.  It appears that the capsule can hold 20 Chronomage spheres in each chamber.  An enruned opening is situated between both halves of the capsule.  The brass and gold capsule contains no brass and gold spheres in the Wehnimer's Landing chamber.
The capsule can not be worn.
Analysis of a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a container to hold your Chronomage spheres.  The spheres must NOT be attuned to you, used in a waiting room, or have an expirations.  This capsule holds 20 spheres in each chamber.  This can be expanded to hold more by special vouchers or rare merchants that will dabble in such arts.
Usage:
LOOK at MY capsule            - Look at the chambers inside.
PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.
PUSH MY capsule               - Eject a sphere from inside the capsule.
TURN MY capsule               - Change which chamber it is set to.
RUB MY capsule                - Reveal the contents of each chamber instantly.
The brass and gold capsule will cost 525,000 coins.

--------- DISGUISE ELIXIR ITEM - ANALYZE INFO  ---------
This is a Disguise Elixir item.  Depending on its setup, it will change the appearance of the race, culture, and/or gender of a character.  This is a temporary effect -- not a permanent change.
This item provides an aesthetic disguise without any mechanical benefits.  It is Tier 1 (of 2 currently).

The necklet has 10 charges remaining.  The item will NOT crumble when it is used up.  Any willing merchant can recharge the item to have a maximum of 10 charges; some less frequent merchants may be able to recharge higher than that.

Each charge on this necklet nets the character roughly 8 hours and 0 minutes of disguise time until the disguise is eliminated (either through naturally running its course, removing the item prematurely via PULL).  There is a very rare chance during each charge cycle that the disguise will prematurely end on its own well before the full time has elapsed.  Also note that death automatically ousts the disguise from a character.

The necklet is set up to place the following aesthetic attributes on a character.  Altering these settings may only be done on rare occasions by qualified persons; it is not a general merchant service.
Race: Sylvankind
Currently you are able to try to PUSH (to activate), PULL (to deactivate), LICK, and RUB (toggles item's visibility while active) the necklet.

Aesthetic alterations to the item itself are acceptable -- they just must make sense for where the item is worn.  Note that needles come out of the underside of the item, so nothing in the alteration should prevent that from logically occurring.

1. PUT - use this to add food items to the basket.

3. TURN - Use this to remove a food item from the basket.  (must be charged with a small statue)
To create a picnic, follow these steps:
1. PULL - to pull the blanket out.  This will move all food to the blanket, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. PUSH - to clean up the picnic.  This will move all food and the blanket back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The picnic will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
To create a table, follow these steps:
1. PROD - to set the table out.  This will move all food items onto the table, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.

Scarring Others:
To scar others, they must be following you.  Once grouped, you simply POINT the razor at them and they will need to APPROVE it.  Once approved, they will be scarred.

Razors need to be cleansed after they are used, and sharpened when they start to dull.  There are several different ways to clean the razor.  Some come with other effects.

Analysis of a tightly braided staff of slender mistwood crowned with an opulent diamond pegasus indicates the creator has provided the following information:
~*~ Nervestaves ~*~
SCRIPT DETAILS
The staff has a mechanical (combat) script which provides three basic types of functionality that can be broken down into the following categories:

AFFINITY - A special, custom 'bonding' like mechanism.  Any given item can share an Affinity with only one person at a time.  Affinity is gained by wielding the item and landing successful hits against like level foes.

BACKLASH - Potential negative effects, including immobilization, stuns, and nervous system damage, that can occur at random.  As the wielder's Affinity with the item grows, the chance of a Backlash occurring are reduced.

FLARES   - Off-the-Shelf, this item comes with a 'Muscle Memory' flare that, when triggered, will temporarily enhance the wielder's Combat Maneuver Ranks.  The magnitude of the enhancement is based on the degree of Affinity shared with the wielder, while the frequency of the flare is determined by the item's tier.

Unlocked items also possess the potential for an offensive 'Misery Unleashed' flare.  This flare can ONLY be triggered when the item is wielded against like level foes by someone with whom a COMPLETE Affinity is shared.
ITEM DETAILS

This is a tiered item that is currently Tier 2 of 4, which results in a 25% chance for the Muscle Memory flare to trigger when used against like level foes.  It also has the following verbs available:  CLENCH, TOUCH, and STARE.

The braided staff shares a considerable Affinity with someone, but it isn't with you!  This will result in a bonus of 5 to Combat Maneuver Ranks being applied when the Muscle Memory flare is successfully triggered.
Using this item in combat against like level foes will decrease the Affinity Level.
ALTERATION GUIDELINES

This braided staff may be freely altered by any merchant who is comfortable doing so, with the following caveat:  The staff was formed of special saplings that were trained to grow around one another.  In order to reflect this, it should always contain the word 'twisted', 'braided', 'helical', or something similiar in its TAP description.

items.name: a carmine glyph-adorned yoke trimmed with ivory beadwork

raw: The yoke is constructed of layers of carmine brocade and looks like it will span the shoulders and taper down the front of the torso.  Four rows of four faceted glyphs form the yoke's central design, with each ensconced in its own gold setting.  At the moment, all of the glyphs appear dull and lifeless.
It is estimated that a carmine glyph-adorned yoke trimmed with ivory beadwork can store a small amount with enough space for a couple of items.
The yoke can be worn over the front.  The yoke appears to serve some purpose.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of leather, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a carmine glyph-adorned yoke trimmed with ivory beadwork indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Looking over the yoke and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/glyph-adorned/baldric or yoke".  This means the item's article CAN be changed.  Only "baldric" and "yoke" are valid as nouns, and the adjective of "glyph-adorned" is unalterable.  Also, the allowed wear-locations are shoulder-worn for baldrics and front-worn for yokes.  So if your alteration involves changing the noun, realize the wear-location MUST BE changed also.

NOTE:  The script's description of the yoke refers to it as "Constructed of layers of (color) (material)..." and bearing "...rows of faceted glyphs...," so keep that in mind if you request an alteration.  The material and color of the yoke CAN be changed.  This item cannot accept a SHOW description, since the script already utilizes that field.
The color that the charged glyphs glow CAN be changed.  It must be no longer than fifteen characters.
If you were to play with the glyph-adorned yoke, then you'd find that you can analyze, wear, remove, clench, push, and rub it.  RUB releases/casts a charge previously stored from a small statue.
This is a Tier 1 yoke, with four tiers in total.  This yoke is sold OTS with one tier unlocked.
SCRIPT NAME: Glyph Adorned Baldric
This yoke CANNOT be deepened at all.
The glyph-adorned yoke will cost 175,000 coins.

items.name: a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome

raw: The brass and gold capsule is divided into two halves, with the top portion being crafted from glass and the bottom portion wrought from brass and gold.  Through the transparent glass, ten chambers are exposed inside the capsule, each detailed with a miniature replica of the cities and towns across Elanthia.  A glowing ring surrounds the chamber for River's Rest currently.  It appears that the capsule can hold 20 Chronomage spheres in each chamber.  An enruned opening is situated between both halves of the capsule.  The brass and gold capsule contains 6 brass and gold spheres in the River's Rest chamber.
The capsule can not be worn.
Analysis of a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a container to hold your Chronomage spheres.  The spheres must NOT be attuned to you, used in a waiting room, or have an expirations.  This capsule holds 20 spheres in each chamber.  This can be expanded to hold more by special vouchers or rare merchants that will dabble in such arts.
Usage:
LOOK at MY capsule            - Look at the chambers inside.
PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.
PUSH MY capsule               - Eject a sphere from inside the capsule.
TURN MY capsule               - Change which chamber it is set to.
RUB MY capsule                - Reveal the contents of each chamber instantly.
The brass and gold capsule will cost 500,000 coins.

Welcome to Kraet Styles, the premiere place to find Kraet styles and clothing.  A folded satin cloth dyed madder red can be worn as a chiton and can be styled in one of three utility forms. The cloth can be customized by adding pins or cording to it but they must be from the Kraet Style line in order for them to work.
Currently, the cloth is set to be worn in the observer style.
It has a border of laurel leaf-edged and is fashioned of satin that is dyed madder red.
There is a pair of simple pins affixed to it, which will display as 131781-pinned when the garment is worn.
There is a braided gold cord wrapped about it, which will display as -corded when the garment is worn.
You may change how the pins are worn by using TWIST to add new ones.
You may change how the cord is worn by using WRAP to add new ones.

Tiering: The cloth is currently tier 2 of 2.  The cloth has access to the following verbs:
Kneel, Pinch (removes pin), Pull, Push, Remove, Sit, Turn (changes style), Twist (adds pin), Wear, Wrap (adds cord), and Unwrap (removes cord)

Analysis of a tattered pennant indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the pennant's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the pennant's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the pennant's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the pennant may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the pennant's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The pennant's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          81
Deity:                            Koar
Deity Primary Color:              Golden
Deity Secondary Color:            White
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

If the pennant's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the pennant to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY pennant TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.
The pennant can be TUCKed while worn in order to hide it from sight.

raw: This otter-inked flypaper was designed by Flypaper Tattoo Designers.  It will allow you to tattoo your body and will give you special messaging for certain actions taken against the tattoo.
This particular flypaper is fully customized and ready to be placed on your body.  You may FLIP it until you find a suitable location for the tattoo, or RAISE it to tattoo yourself.

Base Tattoo: a pair of rotund otters tattoo
Long Description Tattoo: a pair of rotund brown otters tattoo

Show Description Tattoo: Floating upon a pile of bright emerald kelp, a chubby chocolate brown otter barely stays above the blue-green waters of the vibrant pond inked on the golden brown skin.  A taller, less-rotund otter lays next to its companion, the duo's paws entwined around a particularly colorful rock.  Peeking from beneath the strands of green kelp are various koi fish, their mottled white and orange scales distinct in the crystal clear waters.
Location of Tattoo: Back (this can be changed using FLIP)

(Clench): "Bunching your shoulders, the muscles in your back ripple, causing the very rounded belly of the chocolate brown otter of your rotund otters tattoo to appear more pronounced."

(Slap):  "You slap your rotund otters tattoo, the sting briefly reminding you of the burn of the tattooing process.  In that instance, you think about when the tangled strand of vibrant green kelp first graced your golden brown flesh and how it felt when the ink was injected."
(Stretch):  "You give a mighty stretch, the movement highlighting the ethereal watercolor-like detailing of your rotund otters tattoo."
(Tap):  "You lightly tap your rotund otters tattoo to draw attention to the duo's entwined paws covered in droplets of blue-green water at its center."
(Touch):  "You trace the edges of your rotund otters tattoo, carefully highlighting a curious trio of mottled white and orange koi inked near its lower edge."
Slogan: You may have words or phrases as part of your rotund otters tattoo.  If you do, then they will appear as part of TOUCH.  However, you are not required to create a slogan.

raw: The baldric is constructed of layers of storm grey suede and looks like it would be worn cross-torso from shoulder to hip.  Four rows of two faceted glyphs form the baldric's central design, with each ensconced in its own gold setting. Looking over the baldric and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/ivory-adorned/baldric or yoke".  This means the item's article CAN be changed.  Only "baldric" and "yoke" are valid as nouns, and the adjective of "ivory-adorned" is unalterable.  Also, the allowed wear-locations are shoulder-worn for baldrics and front-worn for yokes.  So if your alteration involves changing the noun, realize the wear-location MUST BE changed also.

items.name: a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome

raw: The brass and gold capsule is divided into two halves, with the top portion being crafted from glass and the bottom portion wrought from brass and gold.  Through the transparent glass, ten chambers are exposed inside the capsule, each detailed with a miniature replica of the cities and towns across Elanthia.  A glowing ring surrounds the chamber for River's Rest currently.  It appears that the capsule can hold 20 Chronomage spheres in each chamber.  An enruned opening is situated between both halves of the capsule.  The brass and gold capsule contains no brass and gold spheres in the River's Rest chamber.
The capsule can not be worn.
Analysis of a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a container to hold your Chronomage spheres.  The spheres must NOT be attuned to you, used in a waiting room, or have an expirations.  This capsule holds 20 spheres in each chamber.  This can be expanded to hold more by special vouchers or rare merchants that will dabble in such arts.
Usage:
LOOK at MY capsule            - Look at the chambers inside.
PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.
PUSH MY capsule               - Eject a sphere from inside the capsule.
TURN MY capsule               - Change which chamber it is set to.
RUB MY capsule                - Reveal the contents of each chamber instantly.
The brass and gold capsule will cost 500,000 coins.

raw: A beige dagswain cape with red-stitched geometric designs has a polished tortoise shell bangle fitted into the left corner where the fabric has been stitched to form a sleeve, while the right corner has a copper and boar tusk cloak pin pinned to it.

Analysis of a beige dagswain cape with red-stitched geometric designs indicates the creator has provided the following information:

A beige dagswain cape with red-stitched geometric designs is part of the Shield Cape Collection, which was purchased at Duskruin in the shop "Shield Thyself".  It is a passive defense item that has a chance to block an incoming blow.  The chance increases with each tier that is unlocked.  If the wearer has no weapons in his hands, no shield/runestaff, or is using a bow/crossbow, then he gets the full benefit of the cape.  Otherwise the chance is halved.
Its current status is OTS and that gives it access to the following verbs: pull (removes brooch), push (adds brooch), remove, turn (removes bangle), twist (adds bangle), wear
To upgrade its abilities, you will need to obtain an unlock certificate.

Brooch Data: (Brooch is Absent) A copper and boar tusk cloak pin can be changed by using PULL to remove the brooch and PUSH to add a new one.  Please note, only specialized brooches will work.  Once your brooch is upgraded from the default piece, it unlocks a 50% chance to retain a charge within it for each successful block.  When the brooch reaches 10 charges, it automatically flares and absorbs all of the charges.

Bangle Data: (Bangle is absent) A polished tortoise shell bangle can be changed by using TURN to remove the bangle and TWIST to add a new one.  Please note, only specialized bangles will work.  Once your bangle is upgraded from the default piece, it provides an additional 25% chance to absorb a charge.  It will not provide this additional percentage chance if the brooch is not upgraded.  Additionally, bangles can have special unlocks to change the flare type.
There are currently 0 charges stored in this beige dagswain cape.

You may alter a beige dagswain cape with red-stitched geometric designs freely providing it does not contradict the messaging.  The cape can never be a jacket, a longcoat, a coat, a robe, or any similar nouns based on its design.  Nor will it ever have a hood.  This garment will attach at the left wrist by a bangle, slide over the arm and across the left shoulder.  It will then dip down the back (under wings for the Aelotoi), under the right arm, and can be pulled across the chest so that it is pinned at the left shoulder with a brooch.
You might be able to have a talented merchant lighten the beige dagswain cape for you or deepen its pockets.
The beige dagswain cape will cost 1,100,000 coins.

items.name: a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome

raw: The brass and gold capsule is divided into two halves, with the top portion being crafted from glass and the bottom portion wrought from brass and gold.  Through the transparent glass, ten chambers are exposed inside the capsule, each detailed with a miniature replica of the cities and towns across Elanthia.  A glowing ring surrounds the chamber for Ta'Illistim currently.  It appears that the capsule can hold 20 Chronomage spheres in each chamber.  An enruned opening is situated between both halves of the capsule.  The brass and gold capsule contains no brass and gold spheres in the Ta'Illistim chamber.
The capsule can not be worn.
Analysis of a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a container to hold your Chronomage spheres.  The spheres must NOT be attuned to you, used in a waiting room, or have an expirations.  This capsule holds 20 spheres in each chamber.  This can be expanded to hold more by special vouchers or rare merchants that will dabble in such arts.
Usage:
LOOK at MY capsule            - Look at the chambers inside.
PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.
PUSH MY capsule               - Eject a sphere from inside the capsule.
TURN MY capsule               - Change which chamber it is set to.
RUB MY capsule                - Reveal the contents of each chamber instantly.
The brass and gold capsule will cost 500,000 coins.

raw: Wrought from misty white zorchar, the weapon's hue resembles the still waters of a lake under pale moonlight.  Rivaling the sharpness of knapped obsidian, its edge has been expertly honed, and the black leather-wrapped hilt is crowned with a broken white skull carved from a single piece of ivory.  It has a small enchanter's glyph.  A strong aura of holy light radiates from the tanto.
There appears to be something written on it.
In the Common language, it reads:
Lightning Strike
The tanto is a dagger that requires skill in edged weapons to use effectively.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of zorchar, a rare metal.  This material cannot be dyed.
Analysis of a glowing white zorchar tanto indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This tanto is a Fighting Knife!  It can hit harder and faster in combat than a normal knife, depending on its level of unlock.  It also lets you challenge other Fighting Knife owners to knife fights!
This tanto is currently Tier 4 of 4 with access to:
RAISE*, TAP, TURN, WAVE**, CLENCH, GAZE, POKE**, TILT*, LICK, POINT**, PULL, SPIN, PINCH, PUSH**, TOSS, TWIST
*  indicates that the verb can be used with player targets.
** indicates that the verb can be used with player and object targets.
Players may choose to set their demeanors to cold or reserved to prevent being bothered for RP purposes.
Many verbs have extra messaging when two fighting knives are in hand.
Other players targeted by a verb while holding a fighting knife will also affect messaging.

---- Animalistic Spirit Armor ----
=General Script Information=
This is armor with the spirit of an animal trapped within it.
The spirit is wild and must be tamed by unleashing attacks against like-level foes, or successfully evading them during combat.
If not fully tame, the spirit within can backlash upon the owner.
Allegiance can be changed, but the new owner must work off the trust gained by the previous owner.
When the wearer is hit, the armor has a chance to unleash Animalistic Instinct, which can knockdown the attacker and disorient them momentarily.
If used with an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield, there is a chance the armor will call for aid and also add the weapon/shield's Animalistic Fury flares to the response.
=Alteration Guidelines=
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and show of this armor are fine.
* Any merchant can change the associated Armor Accents to match the alteration.
* Some merchants can change the spirit color, spirit call, spirit group, or how the spirit looks.
NOTE: You cannot change the general type of animal, such as changing a large feline to be a canine, except using certificates.
As well, each spirit type only has certain pre-approved nouns allowed.
=Features=
* Animalistic Instinct Flares (Tier 4 of 4)
The spirit within lashes out defensively with a maneuver-based sonic attack, causing knockdown and roundtime.
If you wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield, there is a chance the armor will call for aid and will add Animalistic Fury flares.
Flares are currently: ON [RUB to toggle]
* Revenge Flares = Unlocked
On a successful evade, there is a chance to unleash Animalistic Instinct flares.  You must be in a forward or greater stance and be an active combatant in combat for the spirit to react.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
If you wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield with Revenge unlocked, there is a chance the armor will call for aid to add Animalistic Fury flares.
* Bestial Barrier = Unlocked
When Animalistic Instinct flares hit, the spirit within shares some of its strength to defend you, causing an increase to your DS for 30 seconds or until the next attack.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Feral Whirlwind = Locked
Once an hour, direct the spirit within to unleash Animalistic Instinct flares against 3 to 5 creatures in the room in a single sonic attack by STOMPing the chain.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Untamed Vitality = Locked
Once an hour, draw on the vitality of the spirit within your armor for an increase in a combination of Health, Mana, and/or Stamina Recovery by CLENCHing the chain.
* Flavor Actions (Tier 1 of 3)
At this tier, this armor captures the following: WEAR, REMOVE, RUB (Flares On/Off), WHISTLE.
Use PROD to make the spirit less visible while using these actions [Spirit is currently: Awake]
* Tameness/Affinity
Tame the spirit to prevent it enacting its rage upon you.
Only one person can have allegiance to this armor's spirit at a time.
The feeling of this spirit toward someone else is tame (Level 12 of 12).
NOTE: To switch this armor's allegiance to you, you must drop its tameness to the previous owner by damaging like-level creatures or evading attacks from like-level foes while in combat.

This blue waxpaper was designed by Pigments of Memory.  It will allow you to tattoo your body and will give you special messaging based on who the tattoo has been created in memory of.
There are several customization fields still missing from this blue waxpaper, however, a talented merchant can continue to work on the tattoo once it is on your body.
The following customizations are in place for a piece of blue waxpaper:
Base Tattoo: (Awaiting your Design - Max 15 Characters) (Awaiting your Design - Max 15 Characters) tattoo
Long Description Tattoo: (Awaiting your Design)
Show Description Tattoo: (Awaiting your Design)
Location of Tattoo: Thigh (this can be changed using FLIP)
Your Pigments of Memory tattoo is designed for a lover.  You have created the following customizations for it:
Your Lover's Name is (Awaiting Name - What is the name of the person you are having tattooed on your body?).
Your Lover is a giantman (this can be changed using TWIST).
Your Lover is male (this can be changed using SPIN).
Your Lover has (Awaiting Eye Color - What is the eye color of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) eyes.
Your Lover has (Awaiting Hair Color - What is the hair color of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) hair.
A phrase you shared with your Lover is "(Awaiting Phrase - What phrase did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body share?)"
A favorite setting of you and your Lover is (Awaiting Setting - Where did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body visit?).
An emotional trigger for you and your Lover is (Awaiting Trigger - What causes you to think of the person you are having tattooed on your body?).
When you use the following verbs, this is how your memories will play out:

(Touch) - You brush your fingers against (tattoo), following the curve of the giantman's face towards his temple, and close your eyes as if remembering running your fingers through his (Awaiting Hair Color - What is the hair color of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) hair.
(Gaze) - You glance at your (tattoo), your lips quirking at a half-memory of similar shared glances.

(Cover) - You lay your hand over your (tattoo), your eyes slipping closed as a momentary pang of mourning fills you.  That pain is suddenly eased by the memory of his smile, and for a brief moment, you could swear you feel his hand upon yours once again.

(Tickle) - You trace the lines of your (tattoo), your mind wandering to a memory of a time that you and (Awaiting Name - What is the name of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) were (Awaiting Setting - Where did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body visit?).  You can almost feel his lips at your ear as he whispers, "(Awaiting Phrase - What phrase did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body share?)."

(Sob) - As you glance at (Awaiting Trigger - What causes you to think of the person you are having tattooed on your body?), you feel your throat suddenly constrict as you are reminded that (Awaiting Name - What is the name of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) is no longer at your side.  You absently lay your hand upon your (tattoo), drawing strength in the fact that you have many, many good memories to draw upon.
Slogan: You may have words or phrases as part of your  tattoo.  If you do, then it will appear only when the tattoo is read.

Welcome to Pigments of Memory waxpaper.  The waxpaper will allow you to tattoo your body and give you a special series of customizations for that tattoo. Once you have settled your options, you may RAISE it to gain the tattoo.
To see the special tattoo that a piece of blue waxpaper will create, please READ it.
Special Alteration Instructions:

Some tattoo artists have permission to alter the waxpaper, but not all.  Please note, that once on the body, the tattoo cannot be modified, so it is important to have the waxpaper completely modified before raising.

This is a tier 1 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            Eonak
Deity Primary Color:              Pale golden
Deity Secondary Color:            Brown
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.

This is a tier 2 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned

Deity:                            Eonak
Deity Primary Color:              Pale golden

Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

[Chamber of Ocularity]

Twisted candelabra made of crimson-stained bone cast flickering shadows across the darkness, revealing an asymmetrical stone chamber covered in carvings of eyes.  An enormous, lifelike painting towers over the area, depicting a slimy grey, tentacular humanoid with three eyes.  The creature's mouth is agape to reveal dozens of sharp teeth, each tipped with a tiny, unblinking eye.  Dark fog roils across the floor in a neverending undulation.

Entry Message: Dark fog envelops you, its dense greyness broken only by the blurry images of hundreds of eyes staring at you.  The world around you fades completely, until all you see are eyes and fog...
Exit Message: Dark fog wraps about you, hiding you from all the eyes.  The chamber grows dim about you...
The stone trinket will cost 100,000 coins.

ALTERATION GUIDELINES

Panel's Appearance: No long or show descriptions, noun must remain panel, article/adjective must describe an image and make sense as both art/adj/panel and art/adj/illusion (do not reference materials).

Concealed Illusion: A skilled merchant may alter the concealed illusion.  Supported customizations include article/adjective, custom long description (noun must remain illusion), and "show" descriptions.  Keep in mind that the illusion itself is a magical creation that is intangible and very obviously an illusion.  These are guidelines, and the merchant always has the final say over what they can or cannot do.

Illusion Color: Must be one or two words that are simple and obvious representations of color.  Avoid words that could be mistaken for an object or that qualify the color's properties.  The chosen color must make sense when describing magical illusion energy.  Great choices include: white, crimson, cerulean, viridian, periwinkle, or colorful.  Avoid words like: lemon, iridescent blue, faded grey, terracotta, or copper.

Illusion Material: Must be a word or short phrase that describes the temporary form taken by the magical illusion energy.  Must always be plural.  Must not reference color in any way.  Any adjectives describing the material MUST occur after a color adjective when considering rules for adjective-order.  In many of the illusion style messages, the illusion color directly precedes illusion material and so they must make adjective-order sense.  The material options that make the most sense will often be light, airy, individually distinct, transparent, and/or reflective.  Great choices include: motes of light, bubbles, ethereal leaves, water droplets, smoke wisps, or sparks.

List Customizations: These customizations are chosen as a number from a pre-made list: Illusion Style, Gesture Style, and Illusion Modifier.  Not all options are available at every merchant.  You must provide any dye additive in addition to the service fee when requesting an Illusion Modifier. Large oval cams of rosewood are wrapped in the bowstring that stretches across a network of darkened steel gears set amid either arm and into the interior of the crossbow.  Aligned atop the stock are a pair of faceted oval crystal lenses serving as sights, with a small trigger extending from the underside of the weapon.  There are no bolts loaded into your heavy siege crossbow.
It has a small enchanter's glyph.
The crossbow is a heavy crossbow that requires skill in ranged weapons to use effectively.
The crossbow can be worn, slinging it across the shoulders and back.  The crossbow appears to serve some purpose.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of ruic, an uncommon wood.
Analysis of a luminous ruic heavy siege crossbow indicates the creator has provided the following information:
|   These crossbows/bows are of gnomish craftsmanship, and very   |
|   intricate.  Any alteration should be along with this theme.   |
|   Bows should have a wooden stock or grip, metallic gears and   |
|   limbs with crystal lenses for sights.                         |
|   If altering these, you may ONLY change the base 15/15/15      |
|   and the settings below.                                       |
|   It is currently a Tier 1, off the shelf version.              |
|   It currently can only be loaded with up to 1 bolt.            |
|   You have access to: WEAR, REMOVE.                             |
Metal Gears  = darkened steel
Metal Cams   = rosewood
Metal Limbs/Stirrup  = silver
Crystal Sights = faceted oval
You might be able to have a talented merchant lighten the heavy siege crossbow for you.
The heavy siege crossbow will cost 1,000,000 coins.
It imparts a bonus of +25 more than usual.
It appears to weigh about 12 pounds.
It is estimated to be worth about 150,000 silvers.
It is predominantly crafted of ruic.
It is a basic project (118 difficulty) for an adventurer to modify.
It has a permanently unlocked loresong by Luxelle.
